visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Named Constants and a Clear Slice
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The numbers 3 and 2 appear all over the scheduler and the slice length is decided with an if/else. Name the constants and use a conditional expression. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: PROCESSES and QUANTUM can be changed in one place, and the slice is the smaller of the remaining time and the quantum, which a single conditional expression says directly.

tests.pattern: (?<![\s\S])\s*P2 done at 3[ \t]*\r?\nP1 done at 7[ \t]*\r?\nP3 done at 8\s*(?![\s\S])
